questions.question: To what useless thing does Ezekiel 15 compare Jerusalem?
options: A withered fig tree that bears no fruit
The wood of the vine, good for nothing but fuel
A clay pot cracked beyond repair
A wide field all overgrown with thorns and briers
questions.answer: The wood of the vine, good for nothing but fuel

questions.question: What is the point of the parable of the vine?
options: The exiles will all be gathered together and restored to their own land once more
The many nations of the wide earth will come at last to worship the LORD in Zion
The inhabitants of Jerusalem are to be given to the fire because of unfaithfulness
The ruined and broken temple will at last be rebuilt in glory after the long exile
questions.answer: The inhabitants of Jerusalem are to be given to the fire because of unfaithfulness

questions.question: Ezekiel 15 says vine wood was already useless even before it was burned.
Like the wood of the _____ among the trees of the forest, so are the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
The fire has consumed both ends and the middle is charred; can it be useful for _____?
